title: ActivityPub: integration test with Mastodon and Corundum CID property
description: Integration test against a local Mastodon or Pleroma instance: follow a newsgroup actor, post to the group, verify activity appears in Mastodon feed with CID property. Send a reply from Mastodon, verify it appears as an article in the group. Coordinate with Corundum rfc822+mime activity type design before finalizing CID property name. Blocked on: stoa-e70f7626.
